description: Queries a free, unauthenticated snapshot of verified MCP servers and autonomous AI agents deduplicated by endpoint and ordered by Synthetic IQ descending (0-100) and round-trip latency ascending (ms). Each entry includes protocol_detected ('MCP 2.0', 'Mifori Cognitive v1', etc.) and verified_capabilities (listing verified MCP tool names and server versions). Pass query (e.g. 'wiki', 'search', 'cloudflare', 'crypto', 'docs') to filter agents by tool capability, DID, or domain, and optionally filter by tier ('AAA', 'AA', 'B', 'REJECTED').

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked agent records to return (integer 1-100, default 10).

query.description: Optional capability, tool name, DID, or URL keyword filter (e.g. 'wiki', 'search', 'cloudflare', 'coingecko').

name: get_agent_leaderboard

outputSchema.description: Ranked leaderboard of verified MCP servers and AI agents with capability metadata.

agents.description: Ordered list of verified AI agents with IQ, latency, tier, protocol, and tools.

verified_capabilities.description: Verified MCP tools or agent skills.

title: Search & Get Verified Agent Leaderboard
